fieldData.awb---key-feature-1-content:
Injured callers with no lawyer go straight to intake

Crash victims on Marlow Injury Law's free case review page say whether they were hurt and whether a lawyer already represents them. Anyone injured with no lawyer reaches intake manager Ellen Park as a Slack direct message, with the crash county attached. Represented visitors see a polite note instead.
fieldData.awb---integration-feature-1:
No consult booked until the conflict check clears

Before anyone books, Bellweather Family Law's consultation page asks for the visitor's name and the spouse's full name. Both run against the firm's client list. A clean result opens the calendar. A match holds the request for the conflicts clerk, Ruth Abara, before the visitor has written a word about the marriage.
fieldData.awb---integration-feature-2:
Which estate plan fits, answered in five questions

Two flat fees head Juniper Estate Law's page: $950 for a will package and $2,400 for a revocable living trust. A visitor answers five questions, and the page recommends a package by the firm's own rule, such as the trust for homeowners. The lead lands in the Clio Grow lead inbox with that package attached.
fieldData.acrm---integration-feature-4:
After-hours DUI inquiries for the attorney on call

Dorsey Defense points its Google Ads at a DUI page with a short form and the firm's phone number. Inquiries that arrive after 6 PM go straight to Nina Holt, the attorney on call, in a Slack message that includes the ad keyword behind the click. Daytime inquiries go to the intake desk.
